author: reece33
quote: Games capped at 30 fps. The romance in not optional, not doing it locks your story progression. The first 2 chapters are literally focused on the relationshipwhich is almost half the game and takes over 20 hours to complete. You can barely steal cars, can't keep stolen cars,  and can't modify stolen cars. The driving in the game is abysmal. If i wanted to play a dating sim id have bought a dating sim not gta. Not worth the money at all.
